expectations.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
expectations.evidence: Line 131: <ThemeProvider brand="ionos" colorScheme="light" platform="comfortable"> wraps all content.

expectations.text: Four stat card elements are present covering active servers, traffic, uptime, and tickets
expectations.evidence: STAT_CARDS array (lines 60-89) defines four entries: 'Active Servers', 'Monthly Traffic', 'Uptime', and 'Open Tickets', each rendered as a <Card>.

expectations.text: CSS @keyframes or animation property is used for entrance animations
expectations.evidence: Lines 11-20: @keyframes fadeInUp and @keyframes fadeIn defined in ANIMATION_STYLES; applied via animation property on header, stat cards, and server list rows.

expectations.text: Each stat card has a different animation-delay value to create the stagger effect
expectations.evidence: Line 277: animationDelay: `${200 + i * 100}ms` — produces 200ms, 300ms, 400ms, 500ms for the four cards respectively.

expectations.text: Colors reference CSS custom properties rather than hard-coded hex values (no hard-coded hex anywhere, including status badge styles)
expectations.evidence: No hard-coded hex values (#xxxxxx) found in the file. STATUS_STYLES uses rgba() for translucent backgrounds and var(--utility/...) tokens for border colors. All other color values use var(--brand/...), var(--neutral/...), or var(--base/...) tokens.

expectations.text: Server list section contains at least 3 rows/items
expectations.evidence: SERVERS array (lines 94-119) contains 3 entries: prod-web-01, prod-db-02, and staging-api-01, each rendered as a row.

expectations.text: Animation durations are in the 200-600ms range
expectations.evidence: All @keyframes animations use durations of 0.35s (350ms), 0.4s (400ms), and 0.45s (450ms) — all within the 200-600ms range.
